propositions: Validation logic is sometimes implemented only in CLI commands while MCP/library/reconciler paths skip the same checks, creating inconsistent enforcement.
Engine-layer-enforcement criterion should trigger when a plan modifies src/rebar/_commands/ or interface modules while naming validation/guard/check work.
The criterion must be registered as ADVISORY posture in the plan-review registry via .rebar/criteria_routing.json overlay.
Detection logic and criterion definition must be documented in docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md following established conventions.
rebar explain project.engine-layer-enforcement must render the criterion definition to users.
